sources.notes: Personally inspected actual fossil panels A/B of2015 Fig1, separately from digital latex-cast-derived CFD panels C/D. A shows low circular relief with curved threefold branches and faint peripheral ornament; B has contrasting preservation. Text distinguishes primary arms, bullae and three shallow apical pits, with low ~2mm relief. Article states counterclockwise branch curvature, but fossil negative/positive orientation can invert apparent handedness. Chosen delivered geometry is explicitly a positive-relief original interpretation, not a claim that displayed negative fossils have same apparent chirality.

sources.notes: Reject first generated concept pit-centered knobs, tree-like veins and overly thick relief. Second concept is useful for three low curved ridges, but still exaggerates pits and repeated ridge grooves; reduce both to shallow subordinate surface relief, no central knobs in pits. Single integrated surface avoids floating anatomical tubes. Palette artistic, 40mm nominal diameter.
